headline: Tesla Deliveries Beat Expectations at 486,532 While Profit Drops
summary: Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter, beating expectations of 461,100, while posting a drop in quarterly profit amid SpaceX merger discussions.
why: Tesla is the world's largest electric vehicle maker by market capitalization, with quarterly vehicle deliveries serving as a primary operational benchmark.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Deliveries beating consensus provided top-line optimism, though declining quarterly net profit weighed on margins.

why_moved: Tesla shares traded firmer post-earnings as delivery volumes rebounded to 486,532 units, exceeding consensus estimates despite a decline in quarterly profit.
